description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Picks the Facebook Page the brand's Meta ads run as, from the brand's ALREADY connected Facebook accounts (ads_page_get lists them); pageId null clears it. Never connects an account (ADS_PAGE_NOT_CONNECTED lists the candidates). Owner/admin, audited in Ads > Agent activity. Spends nothing. Pass agentName and reason. Needs the ads:manage scope.
(Wraps PUT /api/v2/ads/page.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

pageId.description: A connected Page's Meta Page id (or its Facebook account id); null clears the pick.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_page_set
title: Set the brand's ads Page
